title: Airbus Delays Development of Hydrogen-Powered Aircraft
speaker: VOA Learning English

sentences.en: European manufacturer Airbus has announced a delay in its development efforts of a hydrogen-powered aircraft.
sentences.zh: 欧洲制造商Airbus已宣布延迟开发氢动力飞机。

sentences.en: The company explained that progress on the project has been slower and more complex than expected.
sentences.zh: 该公司解释说,该项目的进展比预期的缓慢和复杂。

sentences.en: Airbus had set a goal to make a zero- emission airplane by 2035.
sentences.zh: 空中客车设定了到2035年实现零排放飞机的目标。

sentences.en: The company has not announced a new target date for the plane’s production.
sentences.zh: 该公司尚未宣布飞机生产的新目标日期。

sentences.en: But the French union Force Ouvrière said some of its aircraft workers were recently told the technology was running five to 10 years behind, Reuters news agency reported.
sentences.zh: 路透社报导说, 法国联合部队Ouvrière最近得知,

sentences.en: The French news agency AFP reported Airbus also said it had reduced the program’s budget by 25 percent, but was still examining ways to reduce emissions.
sentences.zh: 法国新闻社AFP报导空中客车也表示已将计划预算削减25%,

sentences.en: "Our ambition and roadmap towards decarbonizing. . .remain unchanged," an Airbus spokesman told AFP.
sentences.zh: 一位空中客车发言人告诉AFP,

sentences.en: In September 2020, Airbus presented three hydrogen-fueled airplane designs, called ZEROe, as part of its efforts to decarbonize.
sentences.zh: 2020年9月,空中客车提出了三种氢燃料飞机设计,称为ZEROe,作为其去碳化努力的一部分。

sentences.en: Other airplane manufacturers, however, have centered more on renewable fuels or developing electric-powered planes for short-distance flights.
sentences.zh: 然而,其他飞机制造商则更多地以可再生燃料为中心,或为短途飞行开发电力飞机。

sentences.en: Airbus noted it has no plans to completely stop developing hydrogen-powered aircraft technology.
sentences.zh: 空中客车指出,它没有完全停止开发氢动力飞机技术的计划。

sentences.en: The company said it sees hydrogen as “a revolutionary energy source for aviation."
sentences.zh: 该公司说,它把氢视为“一种革命性的航空能源”。

sentences.en: However, Airbus said in a statement to Reuters it recognizes that developing systems to produce, transport, and store hydrogen represent “a huge challenge requiring global collaboration and investment."
sentences.zh: 发展生产、运输和储存氢气的系统是“需要全球合作与投资的巨大挑战”。

sentences.en: Difficulties with hydrogen Hydrogen motors do not release gases that can warm the earth’s atmosphere.
sentences.zh: 氢电机的困难不会释放出能够使地球大气层暖和的气体。

sentences.en: Instead, they release water. However, much of the hydrogen used for fuel is produced using natural gas or coal.
sentences.zh: 相反,它们释放出水,但是,燃料所使用的大部分氢是使用天然气或煤气生产的。

sentences.en: Both of these production methods often release carbon dioxide gas, which can warm the atmosphere.
sentences.zh: 这两种生产方法往往释放二氧化碳气体,使大气层暖和。

sentences.en: Running renewable electricity through water can produce hydrogen without adding to carbon emissions.
sentences.zh: 通过水管理可再生电力可以产生氢,而不会增加碳排放。

sentences.en: However, this process is generally more costly.
sentences.zh: 然而,这一进程一般成本更高。

sentences.en: Transporting and storing hydrogen also present problems.
sentences.zh: 氢的运输和储存也存在问题。

sentences.en: As a gas at room temperature, hydrogen takes up a very large space.
sentences.zh: 氢作为室温下的气体 占用了很大的空间

sentences.en: This makes it impossible to use as fuel.
sentences.zh: 这使得无法用作燃料。

sentences.en: It first needs to be turned into a liquid to be transported or stored.
sentences.zh: 首先需要将它变成一种需要运输或储存的液体。

sentences.en: And it needs to be cooled to -253° Celsius to be liquefied.
sentences.zh: 需要冷却到253摄氏度才能液化

sentences.en: This cooling process requires its own source of energy.
sentences.zh: 这种冷却过程需要其自身的能源。

sentences.en: Liquified hydrogen still takes up four times the space of jet fuel.
sentences.zh: 液化氢的消耗空间 仍然是喷气燃料的四倍

sentences.en: The airline industry trade association IATA believes aviation will reach most of its reduction in emissions by using sustainable aviation fuel (SAF).
sentences.zh: 空运协会认为,航空业将使用可持续的航空燃料,实现大部分减排。

sentences.en: It believes other technologies, like hydrogen, will take longer to develop.
sentences.zh: 它相信其他技术,如氢, 需要更长的时间来开发。

sentences.en: SAF uses food and plant waste from cities, agricultural and forest wastes, and other non- petroleum sources.
sentences.zh: 苏丹武装部队使用来自城市的食品和植物废物、农业和森林废物以及其他非石油来源。

sentences.en: This fuel is then added to jet fuel in mixtures of 10 to 50 percent to become SAF.
sentences.zh: 然后将这种燃料添加到喷气式燃料中的10%至50%的混合物中,以成为苏丹武装部队。

sentences.en: Airbus says it agrees that SAF can also play an important part in reducing emissions, particularly for medium and long-distance flights.
sentences.zh: 空中客车说,它同意,苏丹武装部队也可以在减少排放方面发挥重要作用,特别是在中、长距离飞行方面。

sentences.en: I’m Andrew Smith. Andrew Smith adapted this story for VOA Learning English based on reporting from Agence France-Presse and Reuters .
sentences.zh: 我是Andrew Smith, Andrew Smith根据法新社和路透社的报道改编了这个故事,
